description: A clock set in beats per minute, with a time signature and four outputs from bars down to sixteenths

params.text: Sets the tempo in beats per minute, a whole number from 40 to 250, which is the number its display shows
Sets the top number of the time signature, a whole number from 2 to 15, which is the number its display shows
Sets the bottom number of the time signature across four settings, 2, 4, 8 and 16, which is the number its display shows
Holds the bar, beat and eighth counts at the start of the bar for as long as it is held down, and lights while it is held
Starts and stops the clock, and lights while the clock is running; stopped, all four outputs are 0V

outputs.text: 5V for one sixteenth at the start of every beat, and 0V the rest of the time
5V for one sixteenth at the start of every eighth, and 0V the rest of the time
A square wave at the sixteenth rate, swinging between -5V and 5V rather than resting at 0V like the other three
5V for one sixteenth at the start of every bar, and 0V the rest of the time

notes: the clock comes up running, so a module sends pulses from the moment it is placed
the bottom number of the time signature only takes effect at 4 and at 8; set to 2 or to 16 it leaves the bar length and the clock rate at whatever the last usable setting left them
a top number divisible by three over a bottom number of 8 is counted in compound time: six subdivisions to the beat instead of four, and the clock runs half as fast again
the three displays show the tempo and the two halves of the time signature; they are drawn rather than built from controls, so no click can reach them
